subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The scientists have so far focused on __improve cropped__ yields.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**improve**."
 
• The correct form should be "**improving**" to match the present perfect tense used in the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**improving crop yields**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The scientists have so far focused on **improving crop** yields."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "improves crop"** – This option is incorrect as it does not fit the present perfect tense of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "No improvement"** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 4: "improved cropping"** – This option is incorrect as it changes the meaning and structure of the sentence.
